blurb: Guests participate in hot yoga and pilates classes designed to build physical and mental strength, relieve stress, and improve health. Classes include Original Hot Yoga (OHY), Hot Pilates, Yin yoga, and Mobility Flow. The studio offers memberships, class cards, and special passes for visitors and beginners.
